hypothesis: A reduced-difficulty progressive curriculum can establish compositional learning, allowing an interpretable loop-vs-shallow/deep comparison at local scale.
intervention: 3 layers x4 loops (same parameters),12 layers x1 loop (same expanded depth)
dataset: Uniform-split prefix arithmetic mod23; target maximum4 operations; frozen curriculum1-only then1..2 then1..4
split: 2048 unique heldout L4 primary validation,1024 heldout L2 secondary,1024 heldout L4 diagnostic; exclude all from training; keep10000 L4 test and original L10 test unscored. L1 diagnostic may be seen.
primary_metric: Final-step heldout L4 validation accuracy; L2 validation and L1 fit diagnose learning
decision_rule: Learning gate: at least one arm >=50% primary accuracy. Confirm additional seeds1/2 for all arms only if loop >=50% and loop-shallow >=10pp at seed0. Otherwise report exploratory result and stop this bounded stage without a superiority claim. Effective-depth comparisons always report both loop and deep, not just favorable baseline.
controls: same optimizer and selected atomic LR/precision
all arms start fresh; single local GPU serial runs
code_revision: clean HEAD at launch; preserve actual run commit
required_outputs: review with actual commits and push status
